name: Taiwan Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells rectifiers and bar code printers in Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers discrete devices, including rectifiers, protection diode, MOSFETs, general purpose and low transistor, small signal products, such as zener, switching, and schottky diode. The company also provides amplifiers and comparators; automotive voltage, linear voltage, and switching regulator; LED driver; voltage references; and magnetic sensors as well as wide bandgap products.
